lang.title: Language
lang.hint: Each json file in the lang folder is one language (the file name does not matter). Click a language to apply it right away, or drop a language json file onto this window to add it; the phone page changes after it is refreshed.
lang.importExists: The language "{0}" already exists. Replace it?

app.hostBlockedTitle: This page is for phones only
app.hostBlockedBody: You cannot connect to the controller from the server computer itself; open the address in your phone's browser.

main.EnterTheAddressBelowIn: Enter the address below in your phone's browser to connect
main.MouseAndKeyboardAccessFrom: Mouse and keyboard access from the phone
main.OnlyWorksWhilePlayer1s: Only works while player 1's phone is set to "Mouse" or "Keyboard"; then it can control the whole PC. Keep it off unless you need it.
main.Name: Name
main.TheAppIsStillRunning: The app is still running. To close it, right-click its icon near the clock.
main.ScanTheQRCodeWith:
Scan the QR code with your phone and open the link in its browser.
The phone and the computer must be on the same Wi-Fi network.
main.FirewallAsk: Windows Firewall may be blocking phones from connecting on this network. Allow HSH Gamepad on all networks now? (Windows will ask for administrator permission.)
main.FirewallFail: The firewall rule could not be added. Run the app as administrator, or allow HSH Gamepad manually in Windows Firewall.
main.AccessKeyTip: Phones can only connect through the address with this key (e.g. http://192.168.1.5/q2szc). Any other address looks like a site that does not exist.
main.BlockWrongTries: Block IPs that try wrong addresses
main.BlockWrongTriesTip: If one IP tries this many different wrong addresses, it is blocked and this computer won't respond to it for the set time.

tester.DisconnectedWaitingForThePhone: Disconnected (waiting for the phone to reconnect...)
tester.KeysThatWereTestedStay: Keys that were tested stay dimmed  |  {0} / {1}  |  The "Clear" button resets them

port.SoPortIsBeingUsed:
So port {0} is being used instead.

The address at the top of the app window now ends with ":{1}"; open that one in your phone's browser.
port.ThisProgramHasReservedPort:
This program has reserved port {0}.
The app needs this port so the phone can connect without typing a port in the browser. Do you allow us to close the program below?
port.IfYouPressNoPort: If you press "No", port {0} will be used instead.
port.IISHasReservedThisPort:
IIS has reserved this port.
The app needs this port so the phone can connect without typing a port in the browser. Do you allow us to close this useless program that only exists on Windows 11?
port.1PressCtrlShiftEsc:
1. Press Ctrl+Shift+Esc together to open Task Manager.
2. If it opened in the simple view, click "More details" at the bottom (if it is there).
3. Open Details at the top and look in the PID column for the number {0}{1}.
4. Right-click it and choose End task (or End process tree).
5. Come back here and press "Check again".
port.ThisPortHasBeenTaken: This port has been taken by a Windows system service (http.sys); usually IIS, SQL Server Reporting Services or other web apps.
port.1PressWinRType:
{0}1. Press Win+R, type services.msc and press Enter.
2. Find World Wide Web Publishing Service (or SQL Server Reporting Services).
3. Right-click it and choose Stop.
4. Come back here and press "Check again".
port.TheNameOfTheProgram:
The name of the program using the port could not be found; either a web server is running or Windows has taken the port.
1. Press Ctrl+Shift+Esc and close programs like XAMPP, Apache, nginx, Skype or any other web server (in the Processes and Details tabs).
2. If nothing was found, Hyper-V / WSL / Docker may have taken the port: open Command Prompt with Run as administrator and run net stop winnat.
3. Restarting Windows usually works too.
4. Then press "Check again".
port.PortIsStillNotFree: Port {0} is still not free. To free port {1}, close that program following the guide below and press "Check again".
port.TheProgramPathWasNot: The program path was not found (it was probably run with administrator access)
port.UsuallyIISOrAnotherWindows: Usually IIS or another Windows web service
port.TheNameAndPathOf: The name and path of the program were not found
port.IfTheProgramOpensAgain: If the program opens again after you close it, look for helper programs; if it runs again after restarting the computer, find it in the Startup tab of Task Manager and disable it. If you get Access denied, ask an AI what to do.
port.PortIsStillNotFree2: Port {0} is still not free; make sure the program using the port is fully closed and that its name is not in Task Manager either.
port.PortSeemsToHaveBeen: Port {0} seems to have been free for a moment but then closed, or I don't know; try again

enc.TheWindowsH264Encoder: The Windows H.264 encoder was not found

html.ThisNameIsOnlyShown: This name is only shown in the server window and the player list.
html.TheirLayoutReplacesYourCurrent: Their layout replaces your current layout; you can go back with the "Back" button.
html.WhichLayoutDoYouWant: Which layout do you want to view and edit?
html.TheCurrentThemeCodeIs: The current theme code is here. You can edit it, copy it, or paste the code of another theme and press "Apply" (it replaces the current look).
html.RealMouseOneClickTo: Real mouse: one click to lock the pointer, Esc = exit
html.IfTheScreenDoesntRotate: If the screen doesn't rotate, turn off your phone's rotation lock
html.Name: Name
html.YouCanConnectDifferentModes: You can connect different modes (for example a keyboard) to the phone with a converter or whatever you like and use them directly
html.TapThenTouchAgainAnd: Tap, then touch again and hold to move a file or something; this is that delay (laptop touchpads default to 100ms)
html.IfClickDelayWithThe: If click delay with the touchscreen matters to you, set it to 0
html.ReversesTheScrollDirectionWhen: Reverses the scroll direction. When on, it's like a phone: drag down and the page goes down; when off, drag down and it goes up (default = on)
html.OneFingerOnTheTouchpad: One finger on the touchpad: move the mouse. Tap: left click; two quick taps: double-click; tap and immediately touch again and hold or drag: drag (like a laptop touchpad; no double-click here; with delay 0 it is off and clicks have no delay). Two fingers: scroll, and a two-finger tap: right click.
html.MainKeysLikeAltAre: Main keys like alt are held down on double-click
html.LowLatencyIsBetterFor: "Low latency" is better for mouse work and games: the image is always kept very close to live (it may skip slightly sometimes); "Smooth" lets a few frames build up for smoother motion but the image arrives a few tens of milliseconds later.
html.ShowTheMousePointerIn: Show the mouse pointer in the image
html.ShortTouchLeftClickHold: Short touch = left click, hold = right click, one-finger drag = drag (move windows and files), two fingers = scroll, pinch in/out = zoom (Ctrl + mouse wheel).
html.GamesThatUseTrueExclusive: Games that use true Exclusive fullscreen show up black in the image; switch the game to Borderless.
html.IfYourPhoneIsWeak: If your phone is weak or buttons respond with a delay, turn this on (it turns off blurs and some animations)
html.H264LiveVideoUses: "H.264" (live video) uses much less bandwidth and gives higher fps. If the image stays black or shows an error, press "JPEG".
html.TheFullRotationAngleOf: The full rotation angle of the wheel (each side). The output reaches exactly 100% at this angle. 90 to 270 is good for most games; more than 270 will be annoying
html.HowMuchTheWheelTurns: How much the wheel turns for every degree you rotate the phone; for example set to x3 and rotate the phone 90 degrees and the wheel turns 270 degrees
html.AfterTheWheelHasTurned: After the wheel has turned N degrees, the rotation multiplier is multiplied by this value
html.ForExampleYouRotatedThe: For example you rotated the phone 20 degrees and the wheel is at 40 degrees, N is set to 40 and the multiplier is 4; if you rotate the phone another 20 degrees the wheel turns 120 degrees
html.AMultiplierLowerThanThe: A multiplier lower than the sensitivity works in reverse!!
html.IfYouCantHoldThe: If you can't hold the phone truly flat, this may help, but it's best to keep it at 0.0
html.ToMoveAButtonHold: To move a button, hold it and release where you want it. Click a button to open its settings and configure how it looks; when you're done press the "Save" button
html.ExactButtonSizeOnlyActive: Exact button size (only active for buttons that support this option)
html.EachLineIsOneAction: Each line is one action and they run in order. Add lines with the buttons below, or write them yourself:
html.TappingAThemeChangesAll: Tapping a theme changes all appearance colors (and for some, the 3D effect and checkered background) to that theme (your previous custom colors are erased). After that you can edit each color separately.
html.NeonColorOfButtonsAnd: Neon color of buttons and shapes
html.LightAroundButtonsAndTexts: Light around buttons and texts. If the text neon color is not set, it takes the button's neon color
html.TheBackgroundAfterPressIs: The background after press is the color that fills the button while the macro runs.
html.TheseSettingsOnlyAffectThe: These settings only affect the 4 direction buttons. Until you change them, they look like the normal buttons.
html.TheGradientAroundTheWheel: The gradient around the wheel and its frame goes from the top color to the bottom color. Until you set a color it uses the player's main color and the border color.
html.ThePressedColorOfEach: The pressed color of each action button is set separately. Until you change a button's color, it lights up in its own color (for example green for A). In cross mode this same color applies to the pressed part of that button.
html.ChangesAreVisibleOnThe: Changes are visible on the page immediately and saved automatically. The border color of action buttons is set from the "Action buttons" section (they have their own color).
html.YouCanAlsoTypeThe: You can also type the value directly as rgba(‏r, g, b, a‏) or hex (like #ff8800cc).

js.TookPlayerYouStayedIn: {1} took player {0}; you stayed in the same player {2}
js.MouseKeyboardAndTouchScreen: Mouse, keyboard and touch screen are disabled on the server side
js.MoreThan4XboxControllers: More than 4 Xbox controllers cannot be connected, you became PS4
js.MoreThan4XboxWheel: More than 4 Xbox + wheel controllers cannot be connected (a Windows limitation, it doesn't support it)
js.SlotWasTakenYouBecame: Slot {0} was taken; you became player {1}
js.TurnThisOnIfYou: Turn this on if you want the wheel to turn when you rotate the phone
js.TheBrowserDoesntGiveThe:
The browser doesn't give the app access to the phone sensor. Open chrome://flags ← Insecure origins treated as secure ← type the current address ({0}) ← Enabled ← Relaunch.
Then reload the page. (By the way, you can also turn the wheel by hand)
js.ThisBrowserHasNoMotion: This browser has no motion sensor (you can turn the wheel with your finger). Open it with Chrome (Android) or Safari (iPhone).
js.NoDataCameFromThe: No data came from the phone sensor. Maybe the phone has no sensor or "Motion sensors" access is blocked in the browser settings (Site settings ← Motion sensors ← Allow).
js.IfYouHoldThePhone: If you hold the phone flat but the wheel is crooked, press the button under the wheel to set the center again.
js.NoDataWasReceivedFrom: No data was received from the sensor; maybe this phone has no sensor or sensor access is blocked in the browser settings.
js.SensorAccessHasBeenBlocked: Sensor access has been blocked by the browser :(
js.MotionSensorPermissionWasNot: Motion sensor permission was not granted
js.NoActionIsSetFor: No action is set for this macro; set one in the layout settings
js.EachPersonsLayoutForThe: Each person's layout for the wheel and for the normal controller (PS4 / Xbox) is saved separately. You can go back with "Back".
js.SLayoutWasCopiedYou: {0}'s layout was copied{1}; you can go back with "Back"
js.TheGyroscopeOnlyWorksOn: The gyroscope only works on the PS4 controller and is disabled in Xbox mode.
js.ChromeOnlyAllowsTheGyroscope: Chrome only allows the gyroscope on HTTPS and completely disables it on HTTP addresses. To turn it on: open <bdi>chrome://flags</bdi> ← search for <bdi>Insecure origins treated as secure</bdi> ← type the address you are connected to in its box (<bdi>{0}</bdi>) ← set Enabled ← press Relaunch. Then open the page again.
js.ThisBrowserHasNoGyroscope: This browser has no gyroscope. Open it with Chrome (Android) or Safari (iPhone).
js.NoSensorDataCameMaybe: No sensor data came. Maybe the phone has no gyroscope or "Motion sensors" access is blocked in the browser settings (Site settings ← Motion sensors ← Allow).
js.ThisSimulatesThePS4Controllers: This simulates the PS4 controller's own gyroscope and is useful in some games (it raises connection traffic slightly and may drain the phone battery faster during long use)
js.NoDataWasReceivedFrom2: No data was received from the gyroscope; maybe this phone has no sensor or it's from the browser settings
js.TheBrowserDoesntGiveGyroscope: The browser doesn't give gyroscope access: chrome://flags ← "Insecure origins treated as secure" ← enter this server's address and enable it
js.ThisPhoneOrBrowserDoesnt: This phone or browser doesn't support the gyroscope
js.TheBrowserDoesntGiveGyroscope2: The browser doesn't give gyroscope access
js.TheGyroscopeOnlyWorksOn2: The gyroscope only works on the PS4 controller and wheel
js.ThisBrowserDoesntSupportMouse: This browser doesn't support mouse lock
js.MouseLockedPressEscTo: Mouse locked; press Esc to release
js.TheBrowserHasBlockedController: The browser has blocked controller access (Permissions Policy)
js.TheBrowserDoesntGiveController: The browser doesn't give controller access: from chrome://flags enable "Insecure origins treated as secure" for this server's address
js.AControllerWasConnectedBut: A {0} controller was connected but the panel is set to {1}; you should change the controller type
js.AControllerWasConnectedAnd: A {0} controller was connected and its input goes to the computer
js.AControllerWasConnectedTo: A {0} controller was connected; to use it, set the controller type to PS4 or Xbox
js.MouseKeyboardAndTouchScreen2: Mouse, keyboard and touch screen are only for player 1; you became PS4
js.ComputerHzPhonePHz:
Computer: {0}×{1} · {2}Hz | Phone: {3}p · {4}Hz
The quality and Hz cap is always the lower of the two. Quality only changes the image sent to the phone, not the computer's real resolution.
js.TheServerStartedStreamingBut: The server started streaming but sent no image; check the server window (is Windows locked?)
js.TheServerRefusedTheStream: The server refused the stream request: make sure you are player 1 and the "Mouse/Keyboard" box is ticked in the server window
js.MouseAndKeyboardControlIs: Mouse and keyboard control is off in the server window; tick it and select again
js.TheServerStartedStreamingWaiting: The server started streaming; waiting for the first image...
js.ImageStreamingWasStoppedBy: Image streaming was stopped by the server
js.DisplayControlWasDisabledBy: Display control was disabled by the server
js.TheServerDidNotRespond: The server did not respond. An old version of the server app is probably running; build and run the new version (the tester should say "Touch Screen")
js.GettingDisplayInformationFromThe: Getting display information from the server...
js.H264DidNotWork: H.264 did not work in this browser; JPEG was enabled
js.GyroscopeTurnedOffItDoesnt: Gyroscope turned off; it doesn't work in this mode
js.TapAButtonToOpen: Tap a button to open its settings
js.EditingCancelledThePreviousLayout: Editing cancelled; the previous layout is back
js.ThereWasNoLayoutIn: There was no layout in this code
js.ThereWasNoLayoutI: There was no layout I recognize in this code
js.ThisCodeIsForAnd: This code is for {0} and doesn't match the current controller
js.ThisControllersLayoutIsHere: This controller's layout ({0}) is here. Edit it or paste another code and press "Apply"; "Undo" brings it back, and at the end you must press "Save".
js.PS4AndXboxShareOne: PS4 and Xbox share one layout
js.TheLayoutOfAllControllers: The layout of all controllers (PS4 / Xbox and wheel) is here. Edit it or paste another code and press "Apply"; "Undo" brings it back, and at the end you must press "Save".
js.AutomaticCopyFailedTheText: Automatic copy failed; the text was selected, copy it manually
js.AutomaticPasteIsntSupportedHold: Automatic paste isn't supported; hold inside the box and press Paste
js.ClipboardReadPermissionWasNot: Clipboard read permission was not granted; hold inside the box and press Paste
js.LayoutAppliedPressSaveAt: Layout applied; press "Save" at the end
js.ThereWasNoSettingI: There was no setting I recognize in this code
js.ErrorCode101TheData: Error code 101: the data received from the server is invalid
js.YouCantCreateMoreThan: You can't create more than {0} macros
js.YouCantCopyMoreThan: You can't copy more than {0} times
js.ButtonDeletedPressTheRestore: Button deleted; press the restore button to bring it back
js.MacroMAddedClickIt: Macro M{0} added; click it and edit it
js.MultiButtonPressKeysOne: Multi-button: press keys one after another on a single line (at the same time)
js.NoButtonIsHeldYet: No button is held yet; first put a hold line (without time) above
js.MacroSavedAtTheEnd: Macro saved; at the end press save layout
js.WheelSettingsWereResetTo: Wheel settings were reset to default
